notes.title: Update 2.2.3. Better textures.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745546/261a63a40a626aaae42c259ea4fdc95fa781da63.png[/img]
[h1]Additions to roguelike 2.2.3:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A wagon for traveling to the next swamp levels.
[*] Clearer ground textures.
[*] Added grass to the procedural swamps.
[/list]

notes.title: Handcraft George Washington's beer!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745546/fb7882ceeabcc116e1fecfff29e317619126f64e.png[/img]
Find George Washington's beer recipe and brew a roasty Founding Father beer. Follow the original recipe step-by-step and brew a dark and tasty porter with a strong flavor of molasses.
[i]Once the Colonial beer is ready:[/i]
[list]
[*] Friendly bluecoat Patriots might come more easily to your aid!
[*] The molasses in the dark beer boosts your health up to 200.
[/list]

notes.title: A Mysterious Patriot!
notes.content:
[h1]Additions to roguelike 2.1.1:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A friendly bluecoat Patriot might come and fight together with you. Pick up an antique [i]Wistarburgh[/i] bottle to get a rare change to summon this mysterious Patriot!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.1.0.
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes in roguelike 2.1.0:[/h1]
[list]
[*] No need to collect all the Continental coins if you don't want to. Can now also pass to another swamp level if all redcoats have been shot. Added a message that you can kill 'em all!
[*] Can skip messages with the E key or Y on the controller.
[*] Continental coins have bigger collider boxes to make them not randomly disappear. 
[*] Improvements and fixes to the spawning system. Spawning in level 3 was busted and did not work properly.[/list]

Thank you for anyone who has bought [b]The Swamp Fox[/b] and given feedback!

[i]To a year full of shooting redcoats!
Rain[/i]

notes.title: Farming update. Grow cabbages!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745546/127e8fd0be93b6cd7295760f9abb8635489d597c.png[/img]
[h1]Additions to 2.0.7:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to grow cabbages.
[*] Your own garden near the log cabin.
[*] 5% change that redcoats drop cabbage seeds.
[*] Cabbages boost your health to 200.
[*] Cabbages will be ready for harvesting at the next swamp level.
[/list]

Added to the [i]roguelike [/i]gamemode. Also moved the [i]horde [/i]gamemode to the bottom in the main menu, as the [i]roguelike [/i]mode has taken top priority.

notes.title: Roguelike update: Rest in a log cabin.
notes.content:
A cozy log cabin to get your sleep and recharge your health. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745546/41dafc1174912666e3d2aa885cc921f16bafe5f6.png[/img]

Häid jõule / Happy Holidays
Rain

notes.title: Roguelike update: build 2.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
New gameplay changing beverages in Wistarburgh bottles like:
[list]
[*] 10% change to make redcoats freeze upon touching.
[*] 5% change that redcoats drop double the amount of Continental coins.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed upon collecting the beverage "Every kill makes you faster" in a Wistarburgh bottle triggering properly.
[*] Small changes to redcoat spawns.
[/list]

notes.title: Slay 66 redcoats!
notes.content:
Added a single hardcore achievement: kill 66 redcoats.
[h1]Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] Correct redcoat death animations when being hit from the back.
[*] Redcoats take their time to ready their [i]Brown Bess[/i] muskets.
[*] Fixed a rare visual glitch where dead redcoats could perform shooting animations. Was caused by the last update deployed yesterday.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.
notes.content:
[h1]Difficulty:[/h1]
[list]
[*] No more cheap deaths! The game is fair now. 
[*] Redcoats in the open field hesitate for 3 seconds before opening fire. This will make the game much easier but also much more fun.
[*] Redcoats who spawn behind your back will now wait 5 seconds before they perform their first shot. 

[/list]

[h1]Audio:[/h1]
[list]
[*] More sound effects added to the game to prevent enemies sneaking up behind your back!
[*] Redcoat spawn locations are revealed with an authentic drum roll.
[*] [i]Brown Bess[/i] musket sounds are now in correct 3d.
[*] [i]Flintlock pistol[/i] reloading sounds added.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed colliders for redcoats. Raycasts  instead of bullet projectiles for the player [i]Flintlock[/i].
[*] Bigger hitboxes for redcoats.
[/list]

I would like to thank everyone who bought the game! Hopefully these new changes will make the game more fun and fair!
Also a massive thank you to everyone who has uploaded a gameplay video! This update was inspired by watching you guys shoot up tons of redcoats.

I am eternally grateful,
Rain
